accroche.texte: Obsidian Skills teaches your agent Obsidian's formats and its CLI
passages: Teach your agent to use Obsidian CLI and open formats including Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas.
any skills-compatible agent, including Claude Code, Codex, and Open Code

description.texte: Your agent writes notes with wikilinks, callouts and properties, builds Bases with views, filters and formulas, and constructs JSON Canvas canvases, directly in your vault. It works with Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode.
passages: Create and edit Obsidian Flavored Markdown (.md) with wikilinks, embeds, callouts, properties, and other Obsidian-specific syntax
Create and edit Obsidian Bases (.base) with views, filters, formulas, and summaries
Create and edit JSON Canvas files (.canvas) with nodes, edges, groups, and connections
any skills-compatible agent, including Claude Code, Codex, and Open Code
OpenCode auto-discovers all SKILL.md files under ~/.opencode/skills/.

interet.texte: Two skills go beyond notes: defuddle reduces a web page to clean Markdown to save tokens, knap generates files in series from JSON or CSV. The repository follows the Agent Skills specification, so the same skills serve all your compatible agents.
passages: Extract clean markdown from web pages using Defuddle, removing clutter to save tokens
Render Markdown templates from JSON or CSV data using Knap, including batch file generation
These skills follow the Agent Skills specification so they can be used by any skills-compatible agent

exemple_usage.texte: Fetch an article with defuddle, then file it in the vault as a note with properties and wikilinks.
passages: Extract clean markdown from web pages using Defuddle, removing clutter to save tokens

termes_proches.raison: pour Claude Code, le dépôt renvoie à la documentation officielle des Claude Skills.
Obsidian Skills suit la spécification Agent Skills, un format de skills commun à plusieurs agents.
la syntaxe Markdown d'Obsidian comprend les wikilinks, des liens entre fichiers du coffre.
le skill defuddle d'Obsidian Skills retire le superflu des pages web pour économiser des tokens.
le skill knap remplit des modèles Markdown à partir de données JSON ou CSV.
un coffre Obsidian est un dossier de fichiers Markdown que ces skills apprennent à l'agent à créer et modifier.
